agent-configuration.purpose: This configuration defines how automation and coding agents should operate in this repository.

always-do.rule: Treat assets/components as the source for reusable header and footer.
Treat assets/nav as the source for policy/legal pages.
Regenerate search index, translation catalog, and sitemap after content structure changes.
Keep accessibility and compliance notes synchronized with implementation.
Enforce shared layout mounts in all HTML pages: id="header-component", id="footer-component".

memory-rule.rule: Never overwrite or delete previous memory entries. Always add dated logs to the end of the history element.

compliance-and-accessibility.rule: Keep implementation details aligned with standard baselines. Keep wording and claims realistic; do not state formal certification without auditor evidence.
